The '''Room of Morning Mists'''<ref name="CL" /> was a room in the [[Varykino]] lake retreat on the [[planet]] [[Naboo]].<ref name="AOTC" /> The controversial [[poet]] [[Omar Berenko]] wrote one of his most famous works, the disturbing and visionary epic poem ''[[Defense of Naboo]]'', in this room.<ref name="CL" /> [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]] shared dinner in this room prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]], where [[Foodstuff|food]] was served by [[Teckla Minnau]].<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Standard decade|Decades]] later, Skywalker, now known as [[Darth]] Vader, returned to Varykino with Amidala's former [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens|handmaiden]], [[Sabé]]. The two met with the [[Amidalans|Amidalan]] resistance members [[Gregar Typho]] and [[Tonra]] in the Room of Morning Mists.<ref name="DV 3" />
